content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-142. - Credits for prior assessment.
content.summary:
Whenever any sum or any part thereof levied upon any tract in the assessment so set
               aside has been paid and not refunded, the payment so made shall be applied upon the
               reassessment of the tract on account of which the same was paid.
